name: Privatzimmer Hechtsee
beschreibung: The Privatzimmer Hechtsee in Kufstein offers guests straightforward accommodation in a quiet location. The Hechtsee is in the immediate vicinity and invites you to take walks. The house is run as an inn and offers simple, clean rooms with traditional ambience. Guests can expect breakfast and enjoy the cozy atmosphere of a private house in Tirol. The proximity to the Kufsteiner Altstadt makes excursions into the town center possible by car or public transport.
